topics.title_zh: 美收紧芯片并封杀蒸馏，英伟达断供东南亚逼停中国旗舰
topics.title_en: US Tightens Chip & Distillation Controls as Nvidia Halts SEA Shipments, Freezing Chinese Flagships
topics.summary_zh: 美国商务部不仅封堵云算力借道东南亚四国（英伟达紧急叫停服务器出货），更联合OpenAI与Anthropic严打API数据蒸馏。Z.AI与Moonshot等头部中国大模型旗舰训练受阻被迫延期，正转向Meta和Google生态求生。
topics.summary_en: Washington tightened cloud loopholes by forcing Nvidia to halt AI server shipments to four Southeast Asian nations, while OpenAI and Anthropic clamped down on model distillation. Chinese labs including Z.AI and Moonshot delayed flagship models, turning toward Meta and Google open ecosystems.

perspective_pro.role_zh: 🟢 战略遏制派 / 白宫政策智库
perspective_pro.speaker_zh: 美国跨党派对华战略特别委员会
perspective_pro.point_zh: 双管齐下切断先进算力走私通道与合成数据寄生链，彻底击穿依赖西方API做蒸馏套壳的投机路径，巩固前沿AI绝对代差。
perspective_pro.point_en: Closing grey-market compute routing and API distillation ends parasitic shortcuts, securing an absolute generational lead in frontier foundational models.

perspective_con.role_zh: 🔴 开源反抗派 / 产业韧性派
perspective_con.speaker_zh: 开源社群开发者与出海AI团队
perspective_con.point_zh: 极限制裁只能延缓不可逆的技术扩散，切断闭源API反而迫使中国全面押注本土全栈算力与开源权重，加速全球生态分裂脱钩。
perspective_con.point_en: Draconian API gatekeeping and chip curbs merely delay diffusion while driving full-stack domestic substitution and accelerating a bifurcated global AI ecosystem.

linked_tweets.author: @thdxr
linked_tweets.content_zh:
如果你正在开发一个开放权重模型，那么你的游戏就是要忍受所有的财务痛苦，并找出如何继续发展，这样你就可以饱和市场

不幸的是，大多数模型制造商正在退出，并将在未来六个月内增加商业限制

他们会试图榨取他们所拥有的东西并立即杀死它。所有这些模型都将失去相关性

deepseek 是目前唯一致力于长期目标的公司

但这还不够，这将成为开放生态系统的一个问题
linked_tweets.content_en:
if you are developing an open weight model the game is to endure all financial pain and figure out how to keep going so you can saturate the market

unfortunately most model makers are tapping out and will be adding commercial restrictions over the next six months

they will try to squeeze what they have and immediately kill it. all these models will fall out of relevance

deepseek is the only one right now who are committed to the long term goal

it’s not enough though, this will be a problem for the open ecosystem

topics.title_en: Netherlands Resists White House Curbs as ASML CEO Warns China Bans Will Backfire
topics.summary_zh: 面对美国拟进一步收紧对华光刻机出口限制，荷兰政府公开宣布将力拒美方草案，ASML股价应声下挫6%。ASML首席执行官直言过度打压毫无意义，将迫使中国在半导体自研上加倍下注，长远看直接削弱西方行业话语权。
topics.summary_en: The Dutch government declared it will resist new proposed US export restrictions on ASML to China, as ASML shares fell 6%. ASML's CEO warned that over-aggressive bans inevitably force China to double down on indigenous chipmaking tools, eroding the West's long-term technical leverage.

perspective_pro.role_zh: 🟢 欧洲产业自治派 / 光刻巨头高管
perspective_pro.speaker_zh: ASML首席执行官 Christophe Fouquet 及荷兰政经界
perspective_pro.speaker_en: Christophe Fouquet, CEO of ASML & Dutch Officials
perspective_pro.point_zh: 企业必须依附全球市场维持天量研发循环，单方面长臂管辖不仅重创欧洲旗舰企业营收，更亲手为东方竞争对手培养全产业链自研温床。
perspective_pro.point_en: Unilateral long-arm export curbs starve European champions of critical R&D cash flow while unintentionally providing Chinese competitors the ultimate incubator for indigenous tooling.

perspective_con.point_en: Advanced lithography equipment underpins military AI sovereignty; strategic choke points must not be compromised for quarterly corporate balance sheets.

topics.title_zh: OpenAI修定价漏洞削额40%，GPT-6.2陷入变相加价危机
topics.title_en: OpenAI Nerfs GPT-6.2 Usage by 40% Under 'Billing Glitch' Patch, Sparking Outrage
topics.summary_zh: OpenAI突然宣布修复GPT-6.2 Astra与Sol的‘启动计费折扣错误’，导致付费用户额度消耗速度分别暴增40%与25%。在Greg Brockman力推新模型落地之际，大量高强度开发者抨击此举为‘算力承压下的变相偷跑提价’。
topics.summary_en: OpenAI acknowledged correcting a launch billing mistake for GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol that had discounted usage, causing users to hit rate limits up to 40% faster. While Greg Brockman showcased its educational prowess, power developers slammed the sudden adjustment as a stealth price hike driven by server strain.

perspective_pro.role_zh: 🟢 算力基建理性派 / 商业运营团队
perspective_pro.speaker_zh: OpenAI 商业化与基础设施工程团队
perspective_pro.point_zh: 纠正账单折算率是维持超大规模推理集群ROI与健康现金流的刚性底线，防止极少数滥用算力的脚本耗尽公有算力池资源。
perspective_pro.point_en: Correcting an unsustainable billing omission ensures cluster unit economics and healthy ROI, preventing heavy API abuse from starving shared frontier clusters.

perspective_con.role_zh: 🔴 开发者维权派 / 闭源质疑者
perspective_con.speaker_zh: AI独立全栈开发者与企业订阅用户
perspective_con.point_zh: 先用超低门槛将工作流牢牢绑定，再以‘修复漏洞’为幌子隐蔽砍去近半配额，证明闭源商业模型对开销透明度毫无契约精神。
perspective_con.point_en: Luring developers into mission-critical workflows only to slash limits by 40% under the guise of a 'bug fix' exposes the acute vendor-lock-in risk of proprietary APIs.
